notes.title: The game will be changed to free on 12/25/2024
notes.notes: The game will be changed to free on 12/25/2024. Existing buyers will be unaffected.

notes.title: Press Escape To Open The Options Menu
notes.notes: Volume control is now accessible in the options menu. Press the escape key (start button on controller) to open the options menu. To close the game, press the "Exit Game" button. The window resolution can be changed when the "Fullscreen" checkbox is toggled off.
